CustomField.label: Tracking Status
CustomField.description: Provenance of the deviceId sealed into the visitor's Heroku skywave_proof cookie. websdk = real WebSDK anonymous Id (datagraph-linked). synthetic = Heroku-minted UUID because WebSDK was blocked or unavailable. opted_out = visitor explicitly opted out; downstream Data Cloud streaming should skip them. Used by Data Cloud segments to filter to the trackable population.
